          Table "public.measurements_2024"
 Column  |  Type   | Collation | Nullable | Default 
---------+---------+-----------+----------+---------
 id      | bigint  |           | not null | 
 logdate | date    |           | not null | 
 region  | text    |           |          | 
 val     | integer |           |          | 0
Partition of: measurements FOR VALUES FROM ('2024-01-01') TO ('2025-01-01')
Indexes:
    "measurements_2024_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (id, logdate)
    "measurements_2024_region_idx" btree (region)
    "measurements_2024_val_idx" btree (val)
